commitResults.messageTitle: Escape formula-like subject and tag CSV cells
commitResults.messageBody:
Apply the existing reversible apostrophe encoding to joined subject and
tag cells, and decode those columns before import validation. This keeps
spreadsheet exports as plain text without changing imported values.

Cover formula prefixes, literal apostrophes, empty cells, sorted tags,
and existing unescaped CSV rows, and document the encoding.

Fixes #220
Warn when saved data cannot be loaded

commitResults.messageTitle: Make startup warning test platform independent
Update UG and DG to match v1.6 behaviour
commitResults.messageBody:
The UG and DG still describe some AB3 and pre-v1.6 behaviour. The
delete diagram shows a one-step delete, the UI diagram misses the
lesson and subject panels, and the parser diagram uses AB3 names.
About Us still lists the AB3 contact email and has no portfolio links.

Let's bring the docs in line with the current app:
* update the architecture, delete, parser, UI, logic and model
  diagrams, and remove unused AB3 diagrams and images
* describe two-step delete, keeping the view after an edit, and the
  payment summary in the DG, with new use cases and measurable NFRs
* fix outdated UG messages and examples for paid, charge, list, edit
  and find
* replace the AB3 email in About Us with the issue tracker, and add a
  portfolio page for each member
* update the JDK version in SettingUp to 25

commitResults.messageTitle: Ignore case and spaces when finding duplicates
commitResults.messageBody:
Adding "amy  bee" when "Amy Bee" already exists with the same phone,
address and start date creates a second profile for the same student.
The duplicate check compares name and address exactly, so a different
letter case or an extra space slips through.

Let's compare name and address ignoring letter case and repeated
spaces, and the start date ignoring case.

Older data files may already hold such variants. Loading still treats
only exact five-field matches as an invalid file, and recovers the
case or spacing variants the same way as balance-only duplicates, so
no saved student is lost.

Update the UG and DG duplicate rules to match.
Restore filtered view after a failed save

An unknown prefix such as x/ in an add command was read as part of the
previous field. After an address or a note it was saved silently, and
after a lesson time or an outstanding amount it gave a misleading
error about that field.

Edit already rejects unknown prefixes, so let's move that check into
ParserUtil and call it from both parsers. Add now shows its usage
message for an unknown prefix, as edit does.

commitResults.messageTitle: Restore filtered view after a failed save
commitResults.messageBody:
A failed save restores student records but leaves the filter changed by
Add, so a search unexpectedly becomes the full active list.

Restore the original filter in both save-error paths. Cover searched and
archived views, remembered view settings, and both exception types.
